## About
Lexura Service Center is a small car repair and maintenance shop on Village Pkwy in Dublin. Alan runs the shop himself, and he'll talk you through what's wrong with your car in as much detail as you want.
It's a no-frills place. One reviewer put it simply: no fancy paper floor mats, but he does what needs to be done. Another said he doesn't sell you work you don't need, and if he can't handle a job himself, he'll point you to someone who can.
We're open Monday through Saturday and closed Sunday. Neighbors have given the shop a 4.6 rating across 75 Google reviews.

## Services
- Car repair and maintenance: Repair and upkeep for foreign cars, handled by Alan.
- Toyota, Honda and Lexus: One customer called this the place to bring these makes.

## FAQ
Q: Do I need an appointment?
A: No. Alan doesn't set appointments. Just bring your car in during open hours.

Q: What kinds of cars do you work on?
A: Foreign cars. We don't work on Subaru, so for those you'll need another shop.

Q: What if you can't do the repair I need?
A: Alan will tell you straight and give you a referral to a shop that can.
